description: Recorded paired research takes and continuous courses. Locomotion and action entry/exit use MotionBricks. Revised jump/crouch actions replay explicitly labelled contact-prepared original/CC0 motion; their actual displayed poses feed subsequent neural context. Orange-to-red running commands progress from 2.4 to 3.3 native m/s, with played speeds measured separately.
